system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Lambda function to monitor
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: Lambda-API-Health-Dashboard
Resources:
  LambdaHealthDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody:
        Fn::Sub:
        - |
          {
            "widgets": [
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 0,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${func}" ]
                  ],
                  "period": 300,
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "title": "Invocations",
                  "view": "timeSeries"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12,
                "y": 0,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "AWS/Lambda", "Duration", "FunctionName", "${func}", { "stat": "Average" } ]
                  ],
                  "period": 300,
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "title": "Average Duration (ms)",
                  "view": "timeSeries"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 6,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "AWS/Lambda", "Errors", "FunctionName", "${func}" ]
                  ],
                  "period": 300,
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "title": "Errors",
                  "view": "timeSeries"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12,
                "y": 6,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "AWS/Lambda", "Throttles", "FunctionName", "${func}" ]
                  ],
                  "period": 300,
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "title": "Throttles",
                  "view": "timeSeries"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        - func: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
